Custom buckshot made to Beast Slayer request. The inner capsule contains 10 chambers, each with Gravi artifact fragments. A detonator in the base activates the artifact at 425 m/s and accelerates the fragments to supersonic speed. The fragments penetrate medium armor well and cause terrible damage to mutant flesh. 
 
%c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] armor class penetrated: %c[ui_gray_1]BR3
%c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] tissue damage: %c[ui_gray_1]exceptional
 
%c[ui_gray_1]SPECIAL FEATURE:
 %c[d_purple] • %c[ui_gray_2] releases a cloud of Gravi fragments; medium effective range

A fresh shipment of the 6G30 grenade launcher can quickly and effectively clear a whole mutant horde. Fresh from storage. It comes with 18 extra VOG-25 grenades. Its only drawback is a long reload. Use only at medium or long range!

Experimental DNA-deformation injector, Pig-Like type. It temporarily alters the user DNA by inserting a gene component directly into the cells. The user begins to smell like a mutant and is concealed from Flesh and Boars. These mutants then treat the user as one of their own and remain non-aggressive. No clinical trials have been conducted.

Experimental DNA-deformation injector, Lesser Predator type. It temporarily alters the user DNA by inserting a gene component directly into the cells. The user begins to smell like a mutant and is concealed from Dogs and Kikimoras. These mutants then treat the user as one of their own and remain non-aggressive. No clinical trials have been conducted.

Second-generation experimental DNA-deformation injector, Phantom type. It temporarily alters the user DNA with an improved gene component inserted directly into the cells. The user begins to smell like a mutant and is concealed from Pseudo-Dogs, Dogs, Kikimoras, Boars, and Flesh. These mutants treat the user as one of their own and ignore them. No clinical trials have been conducted.

Second-generation experimental DNA-deformation injector, Supreme Predator type. It temporarily alters the user DNA with an improved gene component inserted directly into the cells. The user begins to smell like a mutant and is concealed from Bloodsuckers, Pseudo-Dogs, and Psi-Dogs. These mutants treat the user as one of their own and ignore them. No clinical trials have been conducted.

Third-generation experimental DNA-deformation injector, Phantom type. It temporarily alters the user DNA with an improved gene component inserted directly into the cells. The user begins to smell like a mutant and is concealed from Chimeras, Bloodsuckers, all types of Dogs, Kikimoras, Boars, and Flesh. These mutants treat the user as one of their own and ignore them. No clinical trials have been conducted.

A new experimental Anabiotic developed after the Dusk super-anomaly appeared. It protects the human mind from the stronger psi emissions of new Emission types. \n\nIt has not completed the full testing cycle. Users say it works effectively. Side effects are unknown. Very rare and expensive. [+30% chance to survive when the Raid timer expires]

The RPG-7 rocket launcher is designed to engage armored vehicle-level targets. It may be useful against especially dangerous mutants. Comes with 3 extra OG-7V high-explosive fragmentation rounds. In theory, a well-placed shot can atomize a pack of Bloodsuckers or a Pseudogiant. Use only at medium or long range!

A unique prototype device that tracks anomalies in real time. It looks like a homemade night-vision device and is based on Svarog detector technology: a dynamic emitter probes the area for anomalous distortions, while the interface displays anomaly markers over the user lenses. Unfortunately, its bulky design makes it incompatible with other night-vision devices.
